newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Elec plans higher 97/98 capex.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Elec plans higher 97/98 capex.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday it plans group capital investment of 470 billion yen in the year ending March 1998, up from an actual 415 billion yen in the previous year.
A Matsushita spokesman said the company plans to maintain the level of capital investment in the semiconductor sector at about 100 billion yen in 1997/98, steady from the previous year.
He added that the level of investment for liquid crystal displays (LCDs) would be raised but said the figures would be released during the company's earnings announcement later today.
